name: Homemade chicken meatballs (veg-loaded)

source.author: Family recipe
source.notes: Migrated from the existing foods.json item 'homemade_chicken_meatballs_veg' as the first worked example for the recipe library.

steps: Fry the chopped onion until soft.
Mix chicken, fried onion, grated sweet potato and zucchini, eggs, breadcrumbs, ketchup, salt and pepper.
Spoon onto a pan and fry on medium heat until cooked through.

him.verdict: High protein density (~8.8 g protein / 100 kcal), low sugar, veg baked in — a strong cutting/muscle-retention dinner. Fat is a touch high from the frying, and fiber is low.
suggested_mods: Swap ½ cup breadcrumbs for oat bran or ground oats to lift fiber toward the 32 g/day target
Bake or air-fry instead of pan-frying to cut the added fat
Serve over a big tomato/leafy salad — adds lycopene, vitamin C and fiber the dish itself is short on

her_preconception.verdict: Good lean protein plus iron and choline (from the eggs) — both preconception priorities. Folate is low as-is; easy to fix with greens. Fully cooked, no safety flags.
prenatal_highlights: iron from the chicken (pair with a vitamin-C side for absorption)
choline from the 2 eggs — commonly under-consumed preconception
suggested_mods: Fold a couple of handfuls of chopped spinach into the mix — adds folate and more iron
Serve with a citrus or tomato side to boost non-heme iron absorption
